description: Integration of Engineering Geological Investigation Data and Construction of a 3D Geological Structure Model in the Xiong’an New Area is a data set described in the paper "Integration of Engineering Geological Investigation Data and Construction of a 3D Geological Structure Model in the Xiong’an New Area" in Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery (Editorial Office of Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery, 2019), produced by Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System (the data publisher; the open metadata names no authors). The Xiong’an New Area is located in the plain to the east of the Taihang Mountains, where the shallow strata within 100 m under the earth’s surface mainly consist of alluvial-proluvial and alluvial-lacustrine sand beds and clay layers, with excellent engineering geological conditions. Coverage: the Xiong'an New Area, China, shallow strata within 100 m. The data are held on Geoscientific Data & Discovery Publishing System, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support foundation and underground construction planning in the Xiong'an New Area. Related record: the journal-level record for Acta of Geoscientific Data & Discovery.
